_comment: Maps engine projection short-names to HF named_modules() dotted paths inside one decoder layer. Engine emits 'L${l}-${proj}-out'; reference emits 'L${l}-${dotted_path}-out'. compare_dumps.py uses this to align them. To support a new family (e.g., gemma4), copy this file to compare_label_map.gemma4.json and remap.
